points.description: Hue: states that hue is a narrow range around red (about 0/360 degrees).
points.partial_credit: Half if hue is mentioned as red but no narrow range or value given.

points.description: Saturation and intensity: saturation is high (close to 0.8–1, pure colour) and intensity is a broad/mid range (around 0.5).
points.partial_credit: Half if only one of saturation (high) or intensity (broad/mid) is correct.

rubric.notes: Full marks for saying the petals are segmented in HSI by selecting red hue (near 0/360) with high saturation and a broad, mid-range intensity; exact numbers and wording are not needed. Give 1 mark if only part is right, e.g. only hue, or only saturation. Give 0 for wrong colour space use or unrelated answers.
